rules.text: A change to headings 5401 through 5406 from any other chapter, except from headings 5201 through 5203 or 5501 through 5507.

(A) A change to woven fabric of non-textured polyester filaments of subheading 5407.61 from yarns, with a twist of 900 or more turns per meter, wholly of polyesters other than partially oriented measuring no less than 75 decitex but not more than 80 decitex, and having 24 filaments per yarn of subheadings 5402.44, 5402.47 or 5402.52, or any other chapter, except from headings 5106 through 5110, 5205 through 5206 or 5509 through 5510; or
(B) A change to any other good of heading 5407 from any other chapter, except from headings 5106 through 5110, 5205 through 5206 or 5509 through 5510.
A change to heading 5408 from any other chapter, except from headings 5106 through 5110, 5205 through 5206, or 5509 through 5510.
